blocks.lead: Be part of the **My Sheet Music Transcriptions** team in Terrassa/Barcelona or join us remotely!

blocks.title: Join our band
blocks.body:
We are the go-to production company for new sheet music editions and transcriptions.

Be part of a global, growing, collaborative team that makes the music community play the right notes.

Develop your music and leadership skills, grow professionally, and rest assured **this is going to be a fun gig.**

Our music sounds as good as ever: come and play your part!

blocks.body:
We are a team of 40+ professional music transcribers, arrangers, music editors, musicologists, developers, and engineers based in **Terrassa, Barcelona, Spain.**

Most of our team is local but that doesn’t mean that we’re not looking for talent remotely.

Given the volume of applications we receive, please be aware that we might not reply immediately to your messages, or we might not reply at all if your application is incomplete or not sent to the correct email address.

Make sure you include all the requested information for a position and use the correct email address for each job opening.

blocks.title: No job openings for you?
blocks.body:
**Don’t worry.** We still review unsolicited applications and, if you wish, keep your information in case there’s a suitable vacancy in the future.

Please use this email address to contact us if you don’t see a suitable position for you right now: [job@mysheetmusictranscriptions.com](mailto:job@mysheetmusictranscriptions.com)
